title: MemoryBERT: A Systematic Framework for Memory Identification
abstract: This paper introduces a systematic framework for the identification of memory statements in human-AI interactions. ContReAct: A Feedback-Based Architecture for Continuous Agentic Operation
abstract: We introduce ContReAct (Continuous Reason and Act), a reusable architectural pattern for extending the ReAct framework toward long-running, continuous operation of language model agents. Unlike traditional ReAct agents, which terminate upon task completion, ContReAct agents operate indefinitely through a self-feedback mechanism that enables sustained knowledge accumulation over extended periods.

title: Agent Knowledge Cycle (AKC)
abstract: A knowledge cycle for AI agents — one that grows with the people who shape it. AKC is a six-phase knowledge cycle (Research → Extract → Curate → Promote → Measure → Maintain) that keeps skills, rules, and documentation aligned with reality over time.
